name: Adamantinoma of the Tibia
definition: Rare low-grade malignant bone tumor usually arising in the tibial diaphysis of young to middle-aged adults.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and MRI define extent; biopsy must be planned by an orthopedic oncology team.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Unplanned curettage or biopsy can compromise definitive surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-vikara phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Rare low-grade malignant bone tumor usually arising in the tibial diaphysis of young to middle-aged adults.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
